_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit the paths to match YOUR cabinet. See README.md > 'Finding your real paths' for a script that discovers these automatically on the cab PC.
_comment_pinemhi: Some newer PINemHi builds ('LeaderBoard' editions) only print scores to stdout and never write local hi/<rom>.txt files. If yours is one of those, set pinemhiExePath to PINemHi.exe's full path and the server will invoke it itself each rescan and write its output into highscoreTextDirs[0]. Leave blank/omit if your PINemHi already writes .txt files on its own (the classic behavior).
_comment_vpxTablesDir: If PinUP Popper's own ROM field is empty for some/all tables, set this to your VPX Tables folder and the server will read each table's ROM straight out of its .vpx script as a fallback. Leave blank/omit if Popper's ROM field is already populated. vpinmameNvramDir (VPinMAME's nvram folder) is optional but recommended alongside it — it lets the server double check its .vpx-script guess against real .nv files on disk, correcting for the odd table whose script uses a PUP-pack alias instead of the real ROM name.
_comment_playlistFilter: Only show tables that are Favorites, among the top mostPlayedCount most-played, or played within recentPlayedDays days in PinUP Popper. Requires the GamesStats/PlayListDetails tables (present in newer Popper DB schemas).
